description: This file contains extension methods for the Task class within the Orleans namespace, specifically providing a utility method to observe and suppress exceptions on tasks to prevent unobserved exceptions from finalizer thread escalation.

classes.name: PublicOrleansTaskExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for Task, particularly for ignoring exceptions in tasks to prevent unobserved exception escalation.

methods.name: Ignore
methods.description: Extension method for Task that observes and ignores any exception if the task faults, preventing unobserved exception escalation.
